_comment: Mobilizon instances (https://joinmobilizon.org) - federated AGPL event software. Public GraphQL at {base}/api, no key. Its EventCategory enum has 30 values that map almost one-to-one onto mapsee's, so these arrive correctly filed rather than keyword-guessed; `category` here is only the fallback for the handful with no honest home. NOTE for anyone extending this list: geom is 'lon;lat', longitude FIRST - read it backwards and every European event lands in the Gulf of Guinea. A keyless directory of live instances is at https://instances.joinmobilizon.org/api/v1/instances?count=200 if you want to widen this.

sites.name: Mobilisons (CH)
sites._note: max_pages 25, was 5 (2026-11-08). With START_TIME_ASC, 5 pages of 100 reached only 2026-11-22 (about 35 events a day); p8 ended 2026-12-03, p12 2026-12-19, p16 2027-02-24, and the instance's 2,149 upcoming are 22 pages (the walk stops at `total`; 21 of the last page's 49 lie beyond the 365-day horizon). 0.54-0.87 s a page plus the 1 s crawl_delay: about 40 s. 94-99 of 100 rows carry a geom and 92-99 are MUSIC. Before the order was asked for, 0 of the 479 rows kept were within 90 days.

sites.name: Mobilizon.fr (FR)
sites._note: max_pages 20, was 5 (2026-11-08). With START_TIME_ASC, 5 pages of 100 reached only 2026-11-20: page 1 was 83 rows of 100 already begun (since 2025-03-14) with an end ahead, so about 4 pages were upcoming, and nothing between about 2 weeks and a year out was kept (latest-first had kept 499 rows from 2027-02 to 2027-11, 0 within 90 days). The 1,873 upcoming are 19 pages; the walk stops at `total`. Measured 2026-11-08 (full run, replayed offline): 19 pages in 27.5 s against about 8 s for 5, 1,854 kept, and the store grew from 10,587 to 11,657 rows (8,366 starting 14-365 days out, was 7,302). This instance federates the other three big French ones: of the 1,204 events their deep pages added, it alone carries 1,192, so they stay at 5.

sites.name: Ticketzon (IT)
sites._note: max_pages 55, was 5 (2026-11-08). The adapter now asks searchEvents for START_TIME_ASC, so page 1 starts today, and at about 100 events a day 5 pages of 100 reached only 2026-11-13. Sampled pages (limit 100): p15 ended 2026-11-24, p30 2026-12-13, p45 2027-01-22, p60 2027-02-21, so 90 days out (2027-02-06) is about page 53, of 92 (9,199 upcoming). A page answered in 0.62-0.74 s, no slower at page 92 than page 8, plus the 1 s crawl_delay: about 95 s of the step's 60 minutes, whose whole run took 206 s on 2026-11-06. 6-21 of every 100 rows are CANCELLED (never imported), 72-86 carry a geom, and THEATRE plus MUSIC are 74-97 of 100 from page 8 on. Before the order was asked for, 0 of the 452 rows kept were within 90 days.

sites.name: agenda.collectifs.net
sites._note: max_pages 5 on purpose (2026-11-08). With START_TIME_ASC its 5 pages reach about 13 days ahead (latest kept 2026-11-21), but it is a federated near-mirror of mobilizon.fr, which walks to `total`. Walked to its own `total` the same day it kept 1,700 rows, only 0 of them on no other configured instance. Replayed offline: with mobilizon.fr at 20, also walking this one and its two fellow mirrors (agenda.collectifs.net, event.portes-imaginaire.org, libretic) to `total` grew the store from 11,657 rows to 11,668, for about 50 s and 51 more requests a day to three volunteer-run servers.

_not_included.https://gamenight.host: measured 2026-09-03: 384 of 404 upcoming listings are advertising, not events - marabout/retour-affectif services with a phone number where the title goes, bulk-account sales, and a ten-year 'event' that reached a Kirkland street. Open registration and nobody moderating it. The 20 real listings (a Portland mahjong night, a police commission meeting) are a genuine loss and still not worth five pages of requests a day to a host the spammers have won, or the standing bet that mapsee_spam.py recognises whatever they sell next.
_not_included.https://keskonfai.fr: 205k events, but machine-ingested from tourist-office feeds rather than grassroots - a different kind of source with its own licence to check before use.
_not_included.https://meet.debian.net: measured 2026-09-03: 262 of 291 upcoming listings are advertising - a marabout/retour-affectif campaign and a casino one, the latter dated 457 days long so it could never be cleaned up. Kept at first because 58 rows looked like real Brussels and French cultural events; they are, and they are FEDERATED - of 273 distinct titles, the 55 that are not spam already arrive from other instances in this file, and all 218 unique to it are the spam. Zero unique supply, which is what settled it.
_not_included.https://mobilizon.ethibox.fr: measured 2026-09-03: 22 of 22 upcoming listings are marabout/voodoo services carrying their own dialling code. Nothing on this instance is an event.

_not_included.https://tummeln.kreatives-leipzig.de: measured 2026-09-03: 25 of 34 refused, and the nine that got through are SEO product spam the gate does not recognise (dumbbells, LED fixtures, IPTV resellers, Roman blinds). Zero real events, which is the whole case: a source the per-row gate cannot protect us from because there is nothing behind it.
_not_included.https://mobilizon.picasoft.net: Instance Mobilizon de Picasoft - a Mobilizon instance's GraphQL API. RETIRED 2026-10-05 under the owner's instruction to keep only working and compliant sources (2026-10-05): https://mobilizon.picasoft.net/robots.txt answers `Disallow: /` to every crawler (`User-agent: *`). That is the operator's own file: Mobilizon's stock robots.txt allows crawling, and 67 of the 70 configured instances answered with no such line on 2026-10-05. It had been read under DOCUMENTED_API_TYPES (the 2026-09-30 API line); an operator who refuses every crawler is now taken at its word. To restore: once its robots.txt lets MapseeAggregator in, or the operator says yes, copy the entry back from mobilizon_sources.json at 1fbdfaa; `verify` will then pass it.
